author: Laura Avetisyan, Alex Morales
description: Residents of suburban Manchester head to the polling booths on Thursday to vote in a parliamentary election that threatens to lay bare the danger posed to UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s Labour Party from both the political right and left.
title: Three-Way Manchester Contest Highlights Peril for Starmer in UK

description: Senator Roger Marshall (R-KS) states President Trump’s speech gave a feeling of empathy and hope when discussing his thoughts on the President’s State of the Union address. Marshall also weighs in on what’s next for tariffs, and if he sees a path forward for DHS funding. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Gave Feeling of Empathy, Hope: Sen. Marshall

description: PIMCO Head of Public Policy and Managing Director Libby Cantrill joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the contents of President Trump's State of the Union speech. Cantrill says that the address was "more of a rehashing of the political winds and pretty light on policy details and light on a road map" for the GOP heading into the midterms. She also discusses the potential impacts of Trump's tax cuts and how voters could shift priorities come November. Cantrill speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: SOTU Speech Light On Details, Midterm Roadmap: PIMCO's Cantrill

author: Philip Heijmans
description: Cambodian authorities say a crackdown on online scam compounds has cut activity in half since the start of this year, as they face international pressure to dismantle networks accused of stealing billions annually from people worldwide.
title: Cambodia Claims Its Crackdown Has Halved Online Scam Activity

description: Bloomberg’s Daniel Cancel discusses reports Cuban authorities shot and killed four Americans who opened fire from a speedboat with Florida tags. He discusses what is known about the incident, what this could mean for US & Cuba relations, and if the US will consider this an act of war. Daniel speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: More Questions Than Answers: Cancel on Cuba Shooting

description: In his State of the Union address, the president finally acknowledged affordability concerns. It may be too little, too late, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Nia-Malika Henderson says. (Source: Bloomberg)

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec preview Nvidia earnings with Bloomberg's Ian King as the company's report confronts a market with little patience for AI hiccups. PIMCO's Libby Cantrill also weighs in on Trump's remarks, including domestic and fiscal policy. description: Former US Vice President Al Gore says the energy transition is accelerating faster than many realize. Gore argues that solar and wind are now the cheapest sources of electricity, accounting for 93% of new global power generation last year. He also points to rapid growth in electric vehicle adoption worldwide. He appears on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded on January 20 at the World Economic Forum in Davos. (Source: Bloomberg)

description:
Addressing one of his biggest audiences at perhaps the lowest moment of his second term, President Donald Trump returned again and again in his State of the Union speech to the same message on the economy: Everything is going great.
A resolute Trump was determined to will Americans into a better economic mood, seeking to paint over the affordability concerns at the center of upcoming midterm elections with statistics and self-congratulation.

Nvidia is facing a high-stakes moment with its latest quarterly results with the world waiting for fresh evidence that the AI spending boom remains on track.
To satisfy investors, Nvidia likely needs to deliver another blockbuster report. That means easily topping the forecasts it gave three months ago and setting new targets that are above current Wall Street estimates. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump's State of the Union, Traders Await Nvidia Results | The Opening Trade 2/25/2026

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

On today's show, the US President offered a strident defense of his administration and economic record, declaring the nation is “bigger, better, richer and stronger than ever before”. In the longest-ever State of the Union address, Donald Trump celebrated Olympic victories and military heroism, while at the same time as pledging better fortunes for the public and attacking his rival Democrats.

Also on the show, HSBC raises its bonus pool 10% to $3.93B - the highest in at least a decade.  

Today's guest: Sudha David-Wilp, German Marshall Fund, Vice President of External Relations & Senior Fellow (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Touts Economic Record in State of the Union | Daybreak Europe 2/25/2026
